products.name: Inspectly
products.tagline: AI field inspections with audit-ready documentation.
products.description: Inspection copilot for regulated manufacturing and medical-device quality teams. Inspectors capture photos, voice notes and checklists on a tablet; vision models flag defects, auto-fill the inspection record and produce an SOP-mapped audit trail (ISO 13485 / FDA 21 CFR Part 820 templates included).

features.name: Vision defect detection
features.description: On-device models flag scratches, weld porosity, label misprints and seal defects in real time; fine-tunes on the customer's own defect library within days.

features.name: Voice-to-record
features.description: Inspector dictates findings; Inspectly writes the structured, regulator-expected record with photo evidence pinned to each finding.

features.name: SOP-mapped audit trail
features.description: Every record links to the SOP clause it satisfies; export packs generated per audit scope.

features.name: Re-inspection routing
features.description: Failed items automatically open CAPA-linked re-inspection tasks with due dates.

proof_points.claim: Cut inspection cycle time by 52% at a European medical-device manufacturer
Caught 3.1x more defects per audit than the previous paper process
proof_points.context: Versus the manufacturer's prior paper-based inspections.

proof_points.claim: Raised first-pass documentation compliance from 78% to 96%
proof_points.context: Share of inspection records accepted without rework.

proof_points.claim: Customers typically see about a 40% reduction in re-inspection site visits

competitors.name: AuditTrail Pro
competitors.notes: Strong on document control; no vision capability.
competitors.displacement_angle: Defect detection plus compliant records in one product.

competitors.name: ClipboardX
competitors.notes: Digitizes checklists but produces free-text records auditors reject.
competitors.displacement_angle: Regulator-ready structured records with photo evidence.
